faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO DYSL AI Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the DRDO DYSL AI Junior Research Fellow posts is 14 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow position at DRDO Young Scientist Laboratory Artificial Intelligence (DRDO DYSL AI).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree in a professional course (B.E/B.TECH) with NET/GATE, or a Post Graduate degree in a professional course (M.E/M.TECH), or a Post Graduate degree in Basic Science with NET qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role ranges from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 48,100 per month, plus HRA, depending on the year of service.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DRDO DYSL AI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DRDO DYSL AI Junior Research Fellow recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their GATE score or percentage of marks, followed by a personal or online interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the DRDO DYSL AI Junior Research Fellow recruitment must be submitted in offline mode by post.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official DRDO website, www.drdo.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of DRDO Young Scientist Laboratory Artificial Intelligence?
faq.answer: DRDO Young Scientist Laboratory Artificial Intelligence is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560001.
